blocks.text: Fictional sample document. All parties, dates and amounts are invented.

1. Parties and Date This Service Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into on 14 March 2026 by and between Harborline Analytics Ltd., a company registered in Atlantis (the "Provider"), and Mercer & Vale Foods Inc., a company registered in Elbonia (the "Client").
2. Services The Provider will deliver demand-forecasting and reporting services to the Client as described in the Statement of Work attached as Schedule A (the "Services").

3. Approval of the Statement of Work The Client's procurement committee approves the Statement of Work, provided that the Provider delivers a signed data-protection addendum before any work starts and that total fees do not exceed the budget set out in Schedule A.
4.1 The Provider shall deliver a written forecast report within five (5) business days after the end of each calendar month.
4.2 The Provider shall maintain professional liability insurance for the whole term of this Agreement.
5.1 The Client shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days after receiving it.
5.2 The Client shall give the Provider read-only access to the sales data systems named in Schedule A.
6. Confidentiality Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information secret and shall use it only to perform this Agreement.
7. Term and Termination This Agreement starts on the date in clause 1 and continues until terminated. Either party may terminate it for material breach that remains uncured after written notice.
8. General This Agreement is governed by the laws of Atlantis. Amendments must be in writing and signed by both parties.
